en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a wide view of a makeshift refugee camp on bare ground, with many small huts or shacks in the background and several people walking in traditional dress in the foreground. Printed captions in French and English at the top read "SALONIQUE — Vue générale du Camp des réfugiés / SALONICA — General view of a refugee camp," and a publisher line appears at the bottom left. A modern website watermark (www.elia.org.gr) is superimposed across the lower right.
